description: This file defines a Kivy application demonstrating nested RecycleViews with orthogonal scrolling configurations, including UI layout and behavior for panels and buttons.

classes.name: PanelContainer
classes.description: A container class for each panel, containing a vertical RecycleView with 50 buttons, and dynamically populating its data based on panel index.

methods.name: _populate_inner_data
methods.description: Populates the inner RecycleView with 50 items labeled with the panel index.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Kivy app UI, initializes the outer RecycleView with 20 panels.

calls: inner_rv.data = [{'text': f'Panel {self.panel_index} - Item {i}'} for i in range(50)]
outer_rv.data = [{'panel_index': str(i)} for i in range(20)]
